name: newmark2dsh
description: Newmark Core for DeepSeek Harness：一个插件包携带 Newmark 的 MemoryLab、ComputerUse、Agent API 三个组件（可在插件页独立启用）与两个 Dev 系智能体预设——Dev（创造模式，带 DSH 内核修改权限：运行时检查 + 插件持久化管理 + 组合开发指引）与 rDev（restricted developer，同一智能体但不含该权限），共用 ~/.Newmark 用户库。默认预设由 patch 层声明，不由插件页调控。

meta.title: Newmark Core
meta.description: Newmark MemoryLab (persistent memory + sidebar renderer), Newmark ComputerUse (all modes + takeover stroke), and two Dev-family agent presets — Dev as a creator mode with the harness's kernel-modification tools, and rDev, the same agent without them — over the shared user store. The three components are switched on the plugin page; the default preset is a patch-layer declaration, not a page setting.
